purpose: Authoritative class registry for RFUAV v2.  One entry per taxonomy_id. Vocabulary and per-class evidence are DERIVED (from dialect.py::_V and the recordings manifest); the only authored content is the device -> link_protocol assignment, each with its basis.  Protocol prose lives in link_protocols.json and is never inlined here.

headline_counts.honesty_note: The class count defensible as RFUAV's own capture is 40, NOT 63.  The other 23 classes exist only inside the ZJU and .dat_pic roots, which E-005/E-006 measured as int16-converted with cross-class duplicate content and E-014.3 forbids counting.  Any '>=60 classes' claim built on 63 is a claim about someone else's data.

eval_tier_note: Histogram is over the 40 own-capture classes.  `unsplittable` here means the class has exactly ONE own session, so no leakage-clean split of it exists at any ratio -- it can be trained on or held out whole, never both.  The 23 foreign-only classes are excluded (they have zero own sessions by definition).

eval_tier_disclosure.reconciles_with: manifests/library_totals.csv publishes the same four counts over the same two scopes.  A mismatch between that file and this one means one of the two aggregations is wrong -- they read the same recordings.csv and call the same split_grouped.tier_basis().
eval_tier_disclosure.do_not_quote: Do NOT quote eval_tier_including_foreign == grouped_cv as 'cross-validatable classes'.  Check eval_tier_including_foreign_supported first: 21 of the 63 observed classes carry a tier their own evidence does not support.

link_protocol_caveat: See link_protocols.json::global_caveat (F2).  Every assignment below at evidence level `factory_default_prior` is a PRIOR from vendor documentation for that model, never an on-air measurement, and must not be used as a training label or evaluation ground truth.  Exactly one row is `verified`: uav.parrot.anafi.

protocols_registered_but_unassigned.why: F7: no capture log records which internal/external module was fitted to the EdgeTX/OpenTX host radios (Jumper T14, Jumper TPro V2, RadioMaster Boxer, RadioMaster TX16S).  Registering a protocol without assigning it is the honest encoding of 'plausible but unverifiable' -- see those classes' basis text.

vendor_merge_decision.question: spec sec.2 merges vendor SKYDROID == 云卓(YUNZHUO); dialect.py refused and delegated the call to this file.
vendor_merge_decision.decision: NOT merged in the taxonomy_id namespace.
vendor_merge_decision.rationale: F1: Skydroid H12 and Yunzhuo H12 are two distinct physical radios, both captured.  Merging vendor would collide rc.skydroid.h12 with rc.yunzhuo.h12 and fuse two real classes into one -- data loss disguised as normalisation.
vendor_merge_decision.how_spec_s2_is_honoured: as the non-key field `vendor_family` = 'skydroid_yunzhuo' on all six affected classes, so the merged view is a GROUP BY, not a rename.
vendor_merge_decision.status: deviates from the literal text of spec sec.2 -- OPEN, awaiting ratification.

grouping_key_warning: session_id, never class_dir and never taxonomy_id, is the grouping key for splitting.  See class_aliases.json::_policy -- the same device appears under several directory spellings, and a per-directory split puts one device on both sides of the boundary.
